data.title: Hurricane Polo (EP2), advisory 27/0547Z
data.author: nhcwebmaster@noaa.gov (NHC Webmaster)
data.summary: PREPARATIONS TO PROTECT LIFE AND PROPERTY SHOULD BE RUSHED TO COMPLETION IN BAJA CALIFORNIA SUR. As of 11:00 PM MST Sat Sep 26 the center of Polo was located near 19.8, -113.4 with movement NW at 10 mph. The minimum central pressure was 950 mb with maximum sustained winds of about 120 mph.

data.title: Hurricane Odalys (EP1), advisory 27/0253Z
data.author: nhcwebmaster@noaa.gov (NHC Webmaster)
data.summary: ODALYS CONTINUES TO RAPIDLY WEAKEN. As of 8:00 PM PDT Sat Sep 26 the center of Odalys was located near 21.1, -123.6 with movement N at 7 mph. The minimum central pressure was 979 mb with maximum sustained winds of about 80 mph.

data.title: Tropical Depression Fay (AT1), advisory 27/0235Z
data.author: nhcwebmaster@noaa.gov (NHC Webmaster)
data.summary: FAY VERY SLOWLY MOVING SOUTHWARD. As of 3:00 AM GMT Sun Sep 27 the center of Fay was located near 29.6, -43.9 with movement S at 2 mph. The minimum central pressure was 1010 mb with maximum sustained winds of about 35 mph.
